scores.notes: The house conflicts: left is a stone and half-timbered gabled cottage with tall chimneys, right is a cream clapboard house with a columned porch and shutters; the table is also bare wood on the left and cloth-covered on the right.

The house conflicts: left is a pale grey rendered house with sash windows and a pedimented doorway, right is a red-brick half-timbered cottage with a tiled roof and arched door; the cloth is embroidered on the left and plain white on the right.

Both show a broad mown lawn with ridges and stripes, enclosed by a low garden wall with tall parkland trees and shrubs behind and card-soldier hoops scattered about; the wall reads greyer on the left and redder brick on the right, a minor difference.

The house conflicts: left is a pale grey rendered house with sash windows and a pedimented door, right is a red-brick half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch; the table is cloth-covered on the left and bare wood on the right.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by a pinkish brick garden wall with tall cypress-like and leafy trees behind, hedgehogs and hoops in play; the right adds a topiary arch and a wet patch but the walled ground is compatible.

Both show a mown, striped green lawn inside a low grey-brown garden wall with dense parkland trees and shrubs behind, with card-soldier hoops dotted across it; the right is just a closer view with bare patches.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by the same long pinkish garden wall with dark cypresses and leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky, with hedgehogs and hoops; the right adds a shallow furrow but is compatible.

Both show a rough tufted lawn with hedgehogs enclosed by a red brick garden wall with trees and cypresses behind; the left's topiary arch and the right's foreground tree are compatible with a different viewpoint.

Both show a table on grass under a large oak in front of a red-brick half-timbered house with a tiled roof; the table is bare wood on the left and white-clothed on the right and the porch differs, but the house, tree and garden agree.
Both show a ridged, furrowed lawn with hedgehogs enclosed by a long red brick wall with shrubs and tall trees behind it, with card soldiers bent as arches in the middle distance.
Both show a clothed table on grass under a large oak in front of a pale two-storey clapboard house with shuttered windows, a panelled front door and a porch with slender turned posts and railings.

The oak and long table agree, but the house conflicts: left is a pale clapboard house with shutters and a railed veranda, right is a stone and half-timbered cottage with steep gables, leaded windows and tall chimneys.
